title: Baked Turkish Eggplant
description: A delicious and flavorful Turkish-inspired eggplant dish, made by baking eggplant with garlic, olive oil, and spices.
instructions: Cut the eggplant in half lengthwise and place on a baking sheet.
Drizzle the olive oil over the eggplant and sprinkle with salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Bake the eggplant in the preheated oven for 30-40 minutes, or until tender.
While the eggplant is baking, mince the garlic and set aside.
Once the eggplant is done, remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes.
Scoop the eggplant flesh out of the skin and into a bowl.
Add the minced garlic to the eggplant and mix to combine.
Serve warm or at room temperature.
